page.layout: One page of text, full width; a woodcut-style ornament band at the top, a heading "AD Lectorem." centred, then the body text in italic with a large decorative initial M at the left. No margin notes. Signature "A 3" centred at the foot.

main_text.head: AD Lectorem.

p.i: Magnifici pompam Propy'æi magna postulant ædificia, ( certè quidem haud respuunt ,) quam tamen humilis casa erubescit verecundia. Non est igitur hic permultis præfandum. Do tantum Lectori benevolo (quem ἀδεσπότῳ huic scriptiunculæ & Patronum ambio) suscepti opusculi consilium.

main_text.p: Nimirum ei quærere in proclivi fore suspicor, cur tot inter Christianæ Religionis Systematum examina (quà domestica, quà peregrina) in ore, oculisque omnium, cum debitâ laude volitan- tia, nostrum quoque se ingerat ENCHIRIDION. Rem totam paucis habeto. Ex ista scilicet, quas modo diximus, fœcunda hujusmodi lucubrationum familia, cum aliæ ant prolixi- tate suâ, aut ingratis fortasse minutiloquiis & subtilitatibus Juventuti, aliæ autem aliunde minus nobis placerent, visum est istis omnibus, (quâ quidem pro modu'o nostro liceret,) ire ob- viam
main_text.notes: Page is a heading-led page; the ornament band at top is not text. The initial M is a decorative woodcut letter, transcribed as the first letter of the first word where legible; the word "Magnifici" is printed with its initial joined. Some words in the second-to-last lines are blurred and may contain errors, notably "ant" for "an" and "volitan-tia". The Greek "ἀδεσπότῳ" is a doubtful reading.
